1. (Currently amended) A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, the method comprising:
a. providing a finger palette including:
i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and
ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion, wherein the surface portion is configured to facilitate controlled partial transfer of cosmetic product;
b. securing the finger palette to a finger;
c. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and
d. transferring less than all of the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination by scraping or wiping the surface portion with an applicator tool.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein:
a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and
b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination using an applicator tool, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, with a portion of the first quantity remaining on the surface portion after transfer.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein:
a. the surface portion extends outwardly from a surface center to an outer perimeter; and
b. the surface portion is free, from any first point on the outer perimeter to any second point on the outer perimeter, of features that could trap cosmetics and complicate cleaning of the surface portion, and wherein the surface portion is specifically designed to enable controlled partial removal of cosmetic product via an applicator tool.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without protrusions extending therefrom, and wherein cosmetic product is removed from the surface portion using a separate applicator tool distinct from the user's finger.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar, and wherein the method further comprises removing cosmetic product from the surface portion using an applicator tool prior to transferring the cosmetic product to the destination.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion, and wherein cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination using a separate applicator tool.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further including the step of removing the cosmetic product from a container using a first applicator tool before depositing the cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein:
a. the cosmetic product is a first cosmetic product; and
b. the method further includes the step of depositing a second cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette, wherein the first and second cosmetic products are deposited using separate applicator tools.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein:
a. the first cosmetic product is deposited on a first segment of the surface portion; and
b. the second cosmetic product is deposited on a non-overlapping second segment of the surface portion, wherein each cosmetic product is applied using a separate applicator tool.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 further including the step of blending the first cosmetic product with the second cosmetic product on the surface portion to obtain a blended cosmetic product using an applicator tool.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 14 further including the step of transferring the blended cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to the destination using an applicator tool.

18. (Currently amended) A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a work surface, the method comprising:
a. providing a finger palette including:
i. a ring portion configured to be removably and replaceably securable to a finger; and
ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion extending outwardly from a surface center to an outer perimeter, wherein the surface portion is at least substantially smooth so as to allow a user to scrape an applicator past the surface center in an uninterrupted motion while spreading or blending cosmetic product over the entirety of the surface portion, and wherein the surface portion is specifically designed to enable controlled partial removal of cosmetic product;
b. securing the finger palette to a finger by passing the finger through the ring portion;
c. dispensing cosmetic product from a cosmetics container and placing a first quantity of the dispensed cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette;
d. removing cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette using an applicator tool; and
e. applying a second quantity of the removed cosmetic product to a destination using the applicator tool, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, with a portion of the first quantity remaining on the surface portion.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein:
a. the dispensed cosmetic product is a first cosmetic product dispensed from a first cosmetics container using a first applicator tool;
b. the method further includes the steps of:
i. dispensing a second cosmetic product from a second cosmetics container using a second applicator tool and placing a third quantity of the dispensed second cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and
ii. blending the first cosmetic product on the surface portion with the second cosmetic product on the surface portion to obtain a blended cosmetic product using an applicator tool, wherein the cosmetic product applied to the destination is the blended cosmetic product.
